source.selection_rationale: Newest monthly stable release of microsoft/vscode at S26 start (published 2026-08-26, two days before lock); stable monthly releases carry the accumulated security fixes and match the Electron/Node toolchain documented in the release notes, while insider/main branches move and cannot be pinned reproducibly. The tag resolves directly to a commit object, so the archive address is the immutable full SHA.

toolchain.rust: not required by upstream; the Saber trusted Core builds independently from the repository workspace
toolchain.notes: The Saber monorepo pins Node 24.15.0 for its own gates; desktop builds must use the upstream-pinned 24.18.0. build.mjs fails closed until the exact version is present (SABER_DESKTOP_NODE may point at a cached toolchain).

patches.rationale: Brand the distribution as Saber Studio and isolate its user data without touching any Microsoft mark, service endpoint or build logic
patches.security_impact: identity-only: no protocol, telemetry, update or extension-gallery behavior changes; the OSS product.json already ships without extensionsGallery

patches.rationale: Make the Desktop Agent Workbench the default startup sidebar route: when no view container has been stored yet, prefer the saber-workbench container contributed by the built-in extension, falling back to the upstream default when it is absent
patches.security_impact: startup layout preference only: restores a stored container exactly as upstream does, changes no authority, protocol, telemetry or extension-host behavior

exclusions.extensions_gallery: Absent from the Code-OSS source product.json by design; Saber does not add Microsoft Visual Studio Marketplace endpoints. A governed marketplace choice (Open VSX or private registry) is a later-segment decision after legal review.
exclusions.telemetry: Code-OSS OSS builds key telemetry to a development endpoint and quality is unset; S26 does not enable any telemetry endpoint and no production telemetry is claimed.
exclusions.update: No auto-update endpoint is configured; update, signing and notarization are S36 scope (TBD-BY-SEGMENT).
exclusions.trademark: Patch 0001 removes Microsoft/Visual Studio marks from the shipped identity fields (win32DirName, win32AppUserModelId, darwinBundleIdentifier, shell names). Microsoft trademarks are not redistributed as product branding.

cache.policy: Commit-addressed archives only; downloads land in a .tmp sibling and are promoted by atomic rename only after the SHA-256 matches this lock. Interrupted or mismatched fetches are deleted and never become build inputs. Upstream post-install scripts are never executed by Saber tooling; they only run later inside the reviewed upstream build step itself.
